notable_absence.finding: Unlike its sibling statement page ADVISE, the ADVISOR function page has no Prerequisites section at all - no privilege statement of any kind, fixed or inherited. This is consistent with the batch note that function-reference pages generally carry no access-control content, but it's a notable asymmetry against ADVISE, which at least states a (derived) privilege requirement even though it names no fixed role.

cross_component_finding: Reconsidering the isSynonymOf relation above: the ADVISOR function is a strict superset of ADVISE's capability (session-based async collection via start/list/stop/abort/get/purge actions, multi-query array input, querying system:completed_requests) - flagging this for reconciliation as a possible mis-fit for isSynonymOf, which was defined for pairs the docs declare *functionally identical* (e.g. DROP INDEX/DROP VECTOR INDEX). A more precise predicate might be needed (e.g. 'overlapsWith' or 'supersedes') if this pattern recurs elsewhere.
